resources.string: A stacked recent-apps experience for AOSP Launcher3 and Pixel Launcher.
Enable StackRecentAOSP in LSPosed and include Launcher3 or Pixel Launcher in the module scope. Then use Launcher maintenance below to open launcher settings and tap Force stop to reload the hooks.
Open the current default Home app\'s settings, then tap Force stop to reload StackRecentAOSP hooks. Android requires this final confirmation in system settings.
Could not detect the default launcher. Set a Home app as default first.
Show or hide the app icon on your home screen. You can still open these settings from the LSPosed module page when the icon is hidden.
Debug build for testing. Report any visual or gesture issues before using a release build.
